items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or checks, and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days, not complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown; it is not certification. Risk severity is high for public launch and medium for bounded changes adding no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates, continue only bounded read-only evidence capture and existing containment/measurement work, and permit ordinary reversible growth only when site-specific release, consent, disclosure, provenance, and rollback evidence exists. Do not claim a clean bill of health or request duplicate telemetry.
